title: Neon Fractures
lyrics:

Still smells like nights we dreamed of more

[Final Chorus]
🎵 We’re just glass hearts falling
Shattered on the floor, no warning
All our stars are dim and calling
Lost in echoes of our morning

Glass hearts, fragile and blind
Cut me deep, still can’t unwind
I’m still yours in my mind
Glass hearts leave me behind

[Outro]
Glass hearts…
Falling…
Glass hearts…
Leave me behind…
